animations.name: light kick
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Use the supplied first and last poses exactly, preserving identity, outfit, footwear, pixel art, scale and ground baseline. One crisp light kick from standing guard to full extension. Shift weight onto the planted rear supporting foot, lift the front knee briefly, then snap the front leg straight forward and diagonally downward into the exact compact low kick shown in the final pose, keeping the rear fist raised near the chin and the front arm low over the thigh. Preparation occupies roughly the first third; the kick accelerates smoothly and reaches maximum extension cleanly at the final frame. Keep the supporting foot anchored on the ground baseline; end exactly on the supplied impact pose. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, no extra props, no motion trails or effects.
